text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While feeling the overwhelming presence of 
those gathered at the Takarazuka Kinen, 
Mejiro Dober identifies her weak self as 
the true opponent she must overcome, 
sharpening her focus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that, Air Groove sensed the change 
in Mejiro Dober and looked forward to her 
strong performance.
